import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0060 {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {X Y : Set α} (hX : X ⊆ A) (hY : Y ⊆ A) : f (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f X ∪ f Y := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0060 {α β : Type*} {f : α → β} {X Y : Set α} (hX : X ⊆ A) (hY : Y ⊆ A) : f (X ∪ Y) ⊆ f X ∪ f Y := by
  intro b hb
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hb
  obtain haX : a ∈ X := by
    exact hX a ha
  obtain haY : a ∈ Y := by
    exact hY a ha
  exact Or.elim (Or.inl haX) (Or.inr haY)
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0060 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0060 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0060
